page.title: Pehtlaihnak
page.intro: Na thanhca account pawl kha pehtlaih hna. Na thawngthanhnak in a chuakmi hna cu My Leads ah amah tein a phan, a hruaitu pakhat ah hmanmi le man he.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form My Leads, nifatin hmanmi le lead pakhat man, le lead quality kha LinkedIn ( Conversions API ) ah kuat tthanmi ah a hruai hna.

banner.connected: LinkedIn aa pehtlai. A tu ah hruaitu pawl an lak hna - hi cahmai cu a rauh hlan ah a tharchuah.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn hi server ah hin chiah a si rih lo. Uktu nih LinkedIn app client ID le thuhmi kha a chap a hau.

connect.title: LinkedIn he pehtlaihnak tuah
connect.intro: Na thanhca a zohkhenhtu LinkedIn account in lut. Leadrat na ad account, Lead Gen Form leads le ad statistics lawng a rel, cun na onmi thlennak kha a kuat.
connect.need1: LinkedIn ad account (Zohtu asiloah a cunglei) ah rian pakhat.
connect.need2: A pehtlaimi company cahmai ah rian pakhat (Uktu, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Zohkhenhtu asiloah Hlathlaitu) - LinkedIn hruaitu pawl i hrawm a herh.
connect.need3: Na Lead Gen Forms ah phone nambar biahalnak - phone nambar a ngei lomi hruaitu pawl cu chap khawh an si lo.

connection.fetchTitle: Nithla karlak in hruaitu pawl lak
connection.fetchHint: Minute tlawmpal hnu tlawmpal ah hruaitu thar an zohfel hna i a donghnak ni 7 cu nifatin an zohfel tthan hna, cucaah zeihmanh a tlau lo. Na pehtlaih hlan i a ummi lamhruaitu hna caah hmang, asiloah caan zoh tthannak caah (voikhat ah ni 90 tiang) hmang. Leadrat ah a um cangmi hruaitu hna cu an hlonh hna.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: LinkedIn a hruaitu hna lakah ahodah ruahchannak taktak a hung si ti kha chim. LinkedIn hruaitu pakhat nih a tanglei ah na thimmi dirhmun a phak tikah, Leadrat LinkedIn sinah a report lai, cucaah na campaign report nih hruaitu tthatnak a langhter i LinkedIn na hruaitu tha bik bantuk mi tam deuh a hmuh khawh hna lai. LinkedIn hruaitu ID le email pakhat lei hash lawng kuat a si.
